<main id=\"main-content\" class=\"wrapper\" data-astro-cid-7jjqptxk=\"\"> <div class=\"stack gap-10 content\" data-astro-cid-7jjqptxk=\"\"> <div class=\"content\" data-astro-cid-7jjqptxk=\"\"> <p>In April 2026 one GitHub repo hit <strong>179,000 stars</strong> — not a framework or a model, but a single <code>AGENTS.md</code> file with four behavioral rules derived from <a href=\"https://karpathy.ai/\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">Andrej Karpathy</a>’s <a href=\"https://x.com/karpathy/status/2015883857489522876\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">observations</a> about LLM coding pitfalls. The repo: <a href=\"https://github.com/multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills</a>.</p>\n<p>Karpathy is a founding member of OpenAI and former head of AI at Tesla, widely recognized for his work on deep learning, computer vision, and LLMs. He’s also one of the most followed voices in AI on practical agentic coding workflows.</p>\n<p>His diagnosis zeroes in on <strong>three failure modes</strong> — and the fix is four principles that bias the agent toward <strong>caution over speed</strong>:</p>\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n<table><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Failure Mode</th><th>Description</th><th>Fix</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>1</td><td>Silent Assumptions</td><td>”They make wrong assumptions on your behalf and just run along with them without checking”</td><td>→ Line 1: Think Before Coding</td></tr><tr><td>2</td><td>Overcomplication</td><td>”They implement a bloated construction over 1,000 lines when 100 would do”</td><td>→ Line 2: Simplicity First</td></tr><tr><td>3</td><td>Side-Effect Edits</td><td>”They change/remove comments and code they don’t sufficiently understand as side effects”</td><td>→ Line 3: Surgical Changes</td></tr></tbody></table>\n<p>Line 4 goes beyond fixing — it unlocks a new capability for agents to work independently.</p>\n<p>Here’s the full mapping:</p>\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n\n<table><thead><tr><th>Principle</th><th>Problem It Solves</th><th>The One-Liner</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Think Before Coding</td><td>Wrong assumptions, hidden confusion, missing tradeoffs</td><td>Don’t assume. Don’t hide confusion. Surface tradeoffs.</td></tr><tr><td>Simplicity First</td><td>Overcomplication, bloated abstractions</td><td>Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.</td></tr><tr><td>Surgical Changes</td><td>Orthogonal edits, touching code you shouldn’t</td><td>Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.</td></tr><tr><td>Goal-Driven Execution</td><td>Vague plans with no verification</td><td>Define success criteria. Loop until verified.</td></tr></tbody></table>\n<hr>\n<blockquote>\n<p>⚠️ <strong>Tradeoff:</strong> These guidelines bias toward caution over speed. For trivial tasks (typo fixes, obvious one-liners), skip the rigor. The goal is reducing costly mistakes on non-trivial work, not slowing down simple changes.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<hr>\n<p>Paste this into your <code>AGENTS.md</code>:</p>\n<pre class=\"astro-code github-dark\" style=\"background-color:#24292e;color:#e1e4e8; overflow-x: auto;\" tabindex=\"0\" data-language=\"plaintext\"><code><span class=\"line\"><span>- Think before coding. State assumptions, surface tradeoffs, push back when warranted.</span></span>\n<span class=\"line\"><span>- Simplicity first. Minimum code that solves the problem. Nothing speculative.</span></span>\n<span class=\"line\"><span>- Surgical changes. Touch only what you must. Clean up only your own mess.</span></span>\n<span class=\"line\"><span>- Goal-driven execution. Define success criteria. Loop until verified.</span></span>\n<span class=\"line\"><span></span></span></code></pre>\n<hr>\n<p><em>Source article: <a href=\"https://levelup.gitconnected.com/the-4-lines-every-claude-md-needs-2717a46866f6\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">The 4 Lines Every AGENTS.md Needs</a> by Yanli Liu, published in Level Up Coding (Apr 2026).</em></p> </div> <div class=\"article-back-to-top\" data-astro-cid-7jjqptxk=\"\"> <button type=\"button\" class=\"article-back-to-top__button\" aria-label=\"Back to top\" data-back-to-top=\"\" data-astro-cid-7jjqptxk=\"\"> <svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"40\" height=\"40\" viewBox=\"0 0 256 256\" aria-hidden=\"true\" stroke=\"currentcolor\" fill=\"currentcolor\" style=\"--size:1.2em\" class=\"astro-patnjmll\" data-astro-cid-patnjmll=\"\"> <g data-astro-cid-patnjmll=\"\"><path fill=\"none\" stroke-linecap=\"round\" stroke-linejoin=\"round\" stroke-width=\"16\" d=\"M128 216V40m-72 72 72-72 72 72\"></path></g>  </svg>  </button> </div> </div> <aside class=\"related-posts\" data-astro-cid-7jjqptxk=\"\"> <h2
